grammar.purpose: Distinguish a whole group, a total and a restriction
grammar.explanation: 我们全到了 and 我们全都到了 include every person in the stated group. 一共 counts the total: 一共四个人. 只 restricts what follows: 我只喝水 versus 只有一个人喝水. Most is not all: 大多数人同意 does not establish 全体同意. 只放一点儿油 limits oil; 少放一点儿油 asks for a reduction without establishing an exact amount.

examples.zh: 我们全到了，一共四个人。
examples.py: wǒ men quán dào le , yī gòng sì gè rén .
examples.en: All of us have arrived, four people altogether.

examples.zh: 我只喝水，只有一个人喝茶。
examples.py: wǒ zhǐ hē shuǐ , zhǐ yǒu yī gè rén hē chá .
examples.en: I drink only water; only one person drinks tea.

examples.zh: 大多数人吃米饭，不能说所有人都吃米饭。
examples.py: dà duō shù rén chī mǐ fàn , bù néng shuō suǒ yǒu rén dōu chī mǐ fàn .
examples.en: Most people eat rice; that does not mean everyone does.

commonMistakes.wrong: 三个人同意，所以四个人全同意。
commonMistakes.right: 三个人同意，一个人还没说，不能说全同意。
commonMistakes.why: Three of four agreeing does not establish unanimous agreement.

grammar.pattern: modifier + noun / number + classifier + noun / coordinated nouns
grammar.purpose: Identify the noun phrase before expanding the order
grammar.explanation: 我们小组的晚餐、四个人的晚餐 and 两份米饭 are noun phrases: the head is 晚餐 or 米饭. In 鸡和鱼 the two nouns are coordinated. 清淡的菜 uses 的 after the describing phrase; 我的那份米饭 combines ownership and identification. A noun phrase may serve as an object or topic, but is not automatically a full statement. 本次 source 两 is the weight unit in 二两米饭; numeral 两 in 两份 is already taught. Do not count the numeral as a new lexical sense.

examples.zh: 我们小组的晚餐还没点。
examples.py: wǒ men xiǎo zǔ de wǎn cān hái méi diǎn .
examples.en: We have not ordered our group’s dinner yet.

examples.zh: 两份米饭和一份鱼，先确认配料。
examples.py: liǎng fèn mǐ fàn hé yī fèn yú , xiān què rèn pèi liào .
examples.en: Two portions of rice and one fish dish: confirm the ingredients first.

examples.zh: 我的那份米饭不要油，清淡的菜先上。
examples.py: wǒ de nà fèn mǐ fàn bú yào yóu , qīng dàn de cài xiān shàng .
examples.en: Do not add oil to my rice portion; serve the lightly seasoned dishes first.

commonMistakes.why: Use a portion counter to request two portions; 二两米饭 instead expresses a weight quantity.

dialogue.title: Ask all four
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the complete order without turning most into everyone.

lines.zh: 人数确认了吗？
lines.py: rén shù què rèn le ma ?
lines.en: Have we confirmed the number of people?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 全到了，一共四个人。这张桌子只能坐四个，正好。
lines.py: quán dào le , yī gòng sì gè rén . zhè zhāng zhuō zi zhǐ néng zuò sì gè , zhèng hǎo .
lines.en: Everyone is here, four in total. This table seats only four, exactly enough.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我今天请客，先问所有人想吃什么。
lines.py: wǒ jīn tiān qǐng kè , xiān wèn suǒ yǒu rén xiǎng chī shén me .
lines.en: I am treating today; let us first ask everyone what they want.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 大多数人想吃米饭，少数不想要。不能替其他人决定。
lines.py: dà duō shù rén xiǎng chī mǐ fàn , shǎo shù bù xiǎng yào . bù néng tì qí tā rén jué dìng .
lines.en: The majority want rice and a few do not. We cannot decide for the others.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 具体是谁？全体组员都看菜单了吗？
lines.py: jù tǐ shì shéi ? quán tǐ zǔ yuán dōu kàn cài dān le ma ?
lines.en: Who specifically? Has every group member looked at the menu?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 三个人要饭，一个不要。其中一个只喝水，另外三个人喝茶。
lines.py: sān gè rén yào fàn , yī gè bú yào . qí zhōng yī gè zhǐ hē shuǐ , lìng wài sān gè rén hē chá .
lines.en: Three want rice and one does not. One drinks only water and the other three drink tea.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 鸡和鱼都可以吗？有蛋吗？
lines.py: jī hé yú dōu kě yǐ ma ? yǒu dàn ma ?
lines.en: Are chicken and fish both okay? Is there egg?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先问配料。我没完全看懂，也不能猜过敏的人能不能吃。
lines.py: xiān wèn pèi liào . wǒ méi wán quán kàn dǒng , yě bù néng cāi guò mǐn de rén néng bù néng chī .
lines.en: Ask about ingredients first. I have not fully understood it and cannot guess whether someone with an allergy can eat it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 菜单写二两米饭，是两份吗？
lines.py: cài dān xiě èr liǎng mǐ fàn , shì liǎng fèn ma ?
lines.en: The menu says two liang of rice; is that two portions?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，两是分量单位，份是份数。先问店里一份是多少。
lines.py: bù shì , liǎng shì fèn liàng dān wèi , fèn shì fèn shǔ . xiān wèn diàn lǐ yī fèn shì duō shao .
lines.en: No, liang is a weight unit and fen counts portions. Ask the restaurant how much a portion is.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 油少一点儿，菜先上一部分。我吃饱了就不加饭。
lines.py: yóu shǎo yì diǎn ér , cài xiān shàng yī bù fèn . wǒ chī bǎo le jiù bù jiā fàn .
lines.en: A little less oil, and serve some dishes first. Once I am full, I will not add rice.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。大家觉得公平就好，不用因为请客就多点。下次朋友全家来也先问。
lines.py: hǎo . dà jiā jué de gōng píng jiù hǎo , bù yòng yīn wèi qǐng kè jiù duō diǎn . xià cì péng you quán jiā lái yě xiān wèn .
lines.en: Okay. As long as everyone finds it fair; no need to over-order because someone is treating. Ask first when our friend’s whole family visits next time too.
lines.speaker: b

Let the majority choose everything for everyone
Treat 二两 as two portions
questions.answer: Ask every person and clarify portions and ingredients

choices: No, they still need to ask

reading.title: The shared order
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read to distinguish total people, food choices and unconfirmed facts.

lines.zh: 我们小组一共四个人，全到了。这张桌子只能坐四个，人数正好。
lines.py: wǒ men xiǎo zǔ yī gòng sì gè rén , quán dào le . zhè zhāng zhuō zi zhǐ néng zuò sì gè , rén shù zhèng hǎo .
lines.en: Our group has four people in total, all here. This table seats only four, so the number fits.

lines.zh: 我今天请客，但先看预算，也先问所有人。全体组员看过菜单，不等于全都想吃一样的菜。
lines.py: wǒ jīn tiān qǐng kè , dàn xiān kàn yù suàn , yě xiān wèn suǒ yǒu rén . quán tǐ zǔ yuán kàn guò cài dān , bù děng yú quán dōu xiǎng chī yī yàng de cài .
lines.en: I am treating today, but check the budget and ask everyone first. Every member having read the menu does not mean all want the same dishes.

lines.zh: 三个人要米饭，一个不要。多数要饭，少数不要，不能说所有人都要。
lines.py: sān gè rén yào mǐ fàn , yī gè bú yào . duō shù yào fàn , shǎo shù bú yào , bù néng shuō suǒ yǒu rén dōu yào .
lines.en: Three want rice and one does not. Most want rice and a minority do not; we cannot say everyone wants it.

lines.zh: 其中一个只喝水，其他三个人喝茶。鸡和鱼还没定，要先确认有没有蛋。
lines.py: qí zhōng yī gè zhǐ hē shuǐ , qí tā sān gè rén hē chá . jī hé yú hái méi dìng , yào xiān què rèn yǒu méi yǒu dàn .
lines.en: One drinks only water and the other three have tea. Chicken and fish are not decided yet; we must confirm whether they contain egg.

lines.zh: 我没完全看懂配料。对过敏问题要问清楚，不能只看菜名就决定。
lines.py: wǒ méi wán quán kàn dǒng pèi liào . duì guò mǐn wèn tí yào wèn qīng chǔ , bù néng zhǐ kàn cài míng jiù jué dìng .
lines.en: I have not fully understood the ingredients. We must ask clearly about allergies; dish names alone are not enough to decide.

lines.zh: 菜单写二两米饭，这里的两是分量单位，不是两份。一份有多少，还要问店里。
lines.py: cài dān xiě èr liǎng mǐ fàn , zhè lǐ de liǎng shì fèn liàng dān wèi , bù shì liǎng fèn . yī fèn yǒu duō shao , hái yào wèn diàn lǐ .
lines.en: The menu says two liang of rice; liang is a weight unit here, not two portions. How much one portion contains still needs asking.

lines.zh: 清淡的菜先上一部分，油少一点儿。吃饱了就不加，不用为了请客点太多。
lines.py: qīng dàn de cài xiān shàng yī bù fèn , yóu shǎo yì diǎn ér . chī bǎo le jiù bù jiā , bù yòng wèi le qǐng kè diǎn tài duō .
lines.en: Serve some of the lightly seasoned dishes first and use less oil. Stop adding when full; no need to over-order because of a treat.

lines.zh: 付钱的办法先商量，大家觉得公平就好。下次朋友全家来，也要问各人，不替全家选。
lines.py: fù qián de bàn fǎ xiān shāng liáng , dà jiā jué de gōng píng jiù hǎo . xià cì péng you quán jiā lái , yě yào wèn gè rén , bù tì quán jiā xuǎn .
lines.en: Discuss payment arrangements first; it is fine if everyone considers them fair. When our friend’s whole family comes next time, ask each person rather than choosing for the entire family.

choices: Check individual needs rather than assuming unanimity
All members must order identical food
questions.answer: Check individual needs rather than assuming unanimity

questions.q: Does 二两 establish two portions?
choices: No, it names a weight unit
Yes, 两 always means two portions
Yes, the table has two seats
questions.answer: No, it names a weight unit

lines.zh: 【三个人】要米饭，一个不要。多数要饭，少数不要，不能说所有人都要。
lines.py: sān gè rén yào mǐ fàn , yī gè bú yào . duō shù yào fàn , shǎo shù bú yào , bù néng shuō suǒ yǒu rén dōu yào .
lines.en: Three want rice and one does not. Most want rice and a minority do not; we cannot say everyone wants it.

lines.zh: 其中一个只喝【水】，其他三个人喝茶。鸡和鱼还没定，要先确认有没有蛋。
lines.py: qí zhōng yī gè zhǐ hē shuǐ , qí tā sān gè rén hē chá . jī hé yú hái méi dìng , yào xiān què rèn yǒu méi yǒu dàn .
lines.en: One drinks only water and the other three have tea. Chicken and fish are not decided yet; we must confirm whether they contain egg.

extraReadings.title: Count, then ask
extraReadings.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 四个人，全到了。一共四个，不多不少。
lines.py: sì gè rén , quán dào le . yī gòng sì gè , bù duō bù shǎo .
lines.en: Four people, all here. Four altogether, neither more nor fewer.

lines.zh: 三人要饭，一人不要。大多数，不是每一个。
lines.py: sān rén yào fàn , yī rén bú yào . dà duō shù , bù shì měi yī gè .
lines.en: Three want rice, one does not. The majority, not every person.

lines.zh: 一人只喝水，三人想喝茶。谁吃鸡，谁吃鱼，先问才知道。
lines.py: yī rén zhǐ hē shuǐ , sān rén xiǎng hē chá . shéi chī jī , shéi chī yú , xiān wèn cái zhī dào .
lines.en: One drinks only water, three want tea. Who eats chicken or fish? Ask before knowing.

lines.zh: 蛋和油，配料看清。没有确认，不能替人猜。
lines.py: dàn hé yóu , pèi liào kàn qīng . méi yǒu què rèn , bù néng tì rén cāi .
lines.en: Egg and oil: read the ingredients. Without confirmation, do not guess for someone else.

lines.zh: 二两不是两份，份数分量要分开。菜先上一部分，饱了不用加。
lines.py: èr liǎng bù shì liǎng fèn , fèn shǔ fèn liàng yào fēn kāi . cài xiān shàng yī bù fèn , bǎo le bù yòng jiā .
lines.en: Two liang is not two portions; separate portion counts and weight. Serve some dishes first; no need to add when full.
